normal.name: Ravanon
normal.text: Another October art challenge complete. A month of drawings of characters from anime, comics and videogames, using the #Arttrober2026 list published by Stanley Lau. It was fun, but also exhausting—and it killed almost all my free time for a month. But there was still one thing to do: compile all 31 drawings into a single image—so that's what I've gone and done. Any favourites? #Arttrober #Drawtober #Inktober #MastoArt #FediArt #FanArt #Manga #Anime #Comics #Gaming #Cartoon

normal.name: Quester the Quester ⛅
normal.text: #FFIX #VideoGames I went around the entire Forgotten Continent, thinking there was a mountain terrain from the sea to the continent to gain access with Choco. Nope. No idea how to get to it when the Chocograph says all you need are the field, reef, mountain and sea abilities. So I try to consult a guide. Or ten. Not a single one of them mentions that you do need a flying ship to get to the continent even with the chocobo. FFS…
